content:
LAREDO, Texas — Jewelry lovers can shop for a cause this weekend: Kendra Scott is hosting a Giveback Party benefiting Laredo ISD’s Coat them With Love Project on Sunday, Oct. 25, from 2 to 4 p.m. at the Mall del Norte location, according to Laredo ISD.

Shoppers just need to mention the LISD Coat them With Love Project at checkout for a portion of their purchase to support the district’s winter coat drive. Can’t make it in person? The online giveback runs Oct. 25–26 at kendrascott.com with code GIVEBACK-MWNVP.

The Coat them With Love Project collects and distributes warm coats to LISD students heading into the colder months — one of those quiet, feel-good efforts that keeps giving long after the receipts fade.

Sources: Laredo Independent School District announcement (Oct. 22, 2026).

title: Kendra Scott Giveback Party Sunday benefits LISD's Coat them With Love Project
